text: almost 5 years ago, I got the idea of developing an app which gamify your life. by which we could see our progress in levels. there should be an option to add tasks (one time, daily). and 1.5 years ago I found this app. I have been using this app since then. Thank you developers for developing this for free 🆓 I'm a student right now and don't earn much to buy subscriptions. but when I'll start earning, I'll donate for sure.
author: YASH
developer_reply: Thanks so much for your review. We're happy to hear Habitica has been helpful for so long! We're committed to keeping Habitica free, but we appreciate every one of our subscribers. If you’d like to share any feedback with us directly, you can do that via Menu - About - Support - Send Feedback. Happy adventuring!
